purpose: Freeze the structural schema that future shipping T12 progression data must satisfy after activation. This file is not shipping progression data and contains no accepted T10/T11 IDs.

field_contracts.level: integer 1..100; unique; exactly one record for every integer
field_contracts.level_id: stable unique string matching ^t12\.level\.[0-9]{3}$ and corresponding exactly to level number
field_contracts.region_band_id: one frozen connected-world band ID owned by T12 topology only
field_contracts.prerequisite_level_ids: stable T12 level IDs only; level 1 empty; shipping graph acyclic and Level-1 reachable
field_contracts.required_fact_ids: stable accepted fact/binding IDs; T10/T11 concrete IDs permitted only after resolved activation binding proof
field_contracts.progression_effects: non-empty array of practical progression descriptors; no counter/stat-only filler; exact full effect payload may not be reused on another level as fake progression
field_contracts.visible_progression_hook_ids: array of stable visible-change hook IDs; cadence validated independently
field_contracts.milestone_ids: array of stable T12 milestone IDs that resolve in milestone data
field_contracts.one_time_event_ids: globally unique stable T12 progression-event IDs; every level includes canonical t12.event.level.NNN.completed; replay-safe/idempotent

authority_rules: records describe eligibility and progression intent only
records never debit or grant inventory
records never mutate T11 camp state
records never implement T14 global save/version/migration
records never author T32/T44-T52 region content

field_contracts.milestone_id: stable unique string in ^t12\.milestone\.[a-z0-9_.-]+$ namespace; major milestone at level N uses exact t12.milestone.NNN
field_contracts.level: integer 1..100 resolving to a shipping level
field_contracts.kind: major or minor; every ten-level boundary has a major milestone unless a separately accepted exception stays within that band
field_contracts.owner_task: task responsible for authored presentation/content; T12 may own topology but not later-region assets

promotion_requires: T10/T11 integrated at exact activation base

notes: This schema freezes structure, not final gameplay content, prices, difficulty, region assets or unfinished upstream IDs.
Any accepted upstream interface conflict blocks activation or requires a structured ChangeRequest; it is never guessed around.

shipping_files.cross_file_rule: Both files must share schema_version/task_id and must be composed and validated together by validate_progression_contract.py --levels ... --milestones ... before runtime use or final disposition.
